# Annual (December) O(1) human-only pulse for Slot 87 (oe_chr_).
# Ensures ANY playable country (BYZ, CHI, MNG, MCH, TUR, FRA, VEN, Nova Elysia, etc.) records milestones
# with zero AI overhead and zero double-execution (deduplicated via var:oe_chr_col_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now).
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = { oe_chr_col_human_pulse }
}

oe_chr_col_human_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_ai = no
		NOT = { var:oe_chr_col_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			current_month = 12
			current_year >= 1835
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_chr_col_init_c }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_chr_col_init } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_chr_col_init value = 1 }
		}
		oe_chr_col_sync_human_country = yes
	}
}
